articles.title: Agentic AI Moves from Lab Demos to Production with Claude Cowork and GPT-5.4
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude Cowork for OS X, bringing agentic capabilities to everyday knowledge work, while OpenAI launched GPT-5.4 with native computer-use abilities built into Codex, enabling agents to work across applications with minimal human intervention.
key_points: Agentic AI systems can now plan, execute, and complete multi-step tasks autonomously
Claude Cowork brings AI agent capabilities to general knowledge work beyond developers
GPT-5.4 features native computer-use abilities for cross-application workflows

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.4 with 1 Million Token Context Window
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.4 on March 5th, featuring a 1 million token context window and native computer use capabilities, representing a significant leap in AI model capacity and functionality.
key_points: GPT-5.4 supports up to 1 million tokens of context
First general-purpose model from OpenAI with native computer use
Integrated into ChatGPT, Codex, and API platforms

articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Enhanced Coding and Agentic Capabilities
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 4.6 on February 17th, delivering major improvements in coding performance, long context reasoning, and agentic search capabilities.
key_points: Significant upgrades in coding and programming tasks
Enhanced long context reasoning capabilities
Improved agentic search performance

articles.title: Nvidia GTC 2026 Highlights Physical AI and Edge Computing Advances
articles.summary: Nvidia's GTC 2026 conference opened on March 16th in San Jose, showcasing breakthrough developments in physical AI, AI factories, and edge computing technologies.
key_points: Focus on physical AI applications and implementations
Advances in AI factory infrastructure
Edge computing technology developments

articles.title: Meta Acquires Moltbook to Expand AI Agent Social Networking
articles.summary: Meta acquired Moltbook, a social networking platform designed for AI agents, signaling the company's growing focus on autonomous AI systems and intelligent agent development.
key_points: Moltbook enables AI bots to interact in community-style environments
Supports development of AI-powered platforms
Focuses on next-generation digital assistants

articles.title: Global AI Infrastructure Investment to Exceed $600 Billion in 2026
articles.summary: Technology companies are projected to invest over $600 billion in AI-related development in 2026, including AI data centers, cloud computing infrastructure, and machine learning research.
key_points: Massive scale of investment across the tech sector
Focus on AI data centers and cloud infrastructure
AI becoming core business technology rather than experimental

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Founder Launches AI Security Startup Cylake with $45M Funding
articles.summary: Nir Zuk, founder of Palo Alto Networks, unveiled Cylake, a new cybersecurity startup developing AI-driven security platforms for organizations that cannot rely on public cloud infrastructure.
key_points: $45 million in Seed funding secured
Co-founded by Wilson Xu and Ehud (Udi) Shamir
Targets organizations needing non-cloud security solutions

articles.title: IronSource Founders Raise $58M for AI E-commerce Startup ZyG
articles.summary: The founders of ironSource secured $58 million in Seed funding for ZyG, an AI e-commerce platform that predicts product success before launch and builds brands using AI agents and financing.
key_points: $58 million Seed funding round
Platform predicts product success pre-launch
Uses AI agents and financing for brand building

articles.title: ServiceNow Acquires Traceloop in $60-80M Deal
articles.summary: ServiceNow acquired Traceloop for $60-80 million, marking its third Israeli acquisition in under three months, following previous acquisitions of Armis Security and Pyramid Analytics.
key_points: Third Israeli acquisition by ServiceNow in three months
Deal value between $60-80 million
Continues ServiceNow's expansion in Israeli tech market

articles.title: Enterprise AI Adoption Reaches 84% with Dedicated Budgets
articles.summary: Recent research shows 84% of enterprises maintain dedicated AI budgets, with over 90% expecting these budgets to grow in the next two years, indicating AI's transition to strategic business asset.
key_points: 84% of enterprises have dedicated AI budgets
90% expect budget growth in next two years
AI used for automation, customer support, data analysis, and marketing

articles.title: AI Ethics and Regulation Trends in 2026
articles.summary: The technology industry is increasingly focusing on AI ethics and regulation, ensuring responsible AI deployment with transparent, fair systems aligned with human values.
key_points: Development of transparent and fair AI systems
Focus on AI alignment with human values
Creating trust and reliability across AI applications

articles.title: Quantum Computing Advances in 2026
articles.summary: Quantum computing is gaining momentum with breakthroughs in quantum algorithms, error correction, and hybrid quantum-classical systems, enabling solutions to complex problems impossible for classical computers.
key_points: Advances in quantum algorithms and error correction
Hybrid quantum-classical systems development
Cloud-based quantum computing services democratizing access

articles.title: Edge Computing and IoT Integration Trends
articles.summary: Edge computing is emerging as a critical trend, processing data closer to its source to reduce latency and improve performance, particularly important for autonomous vehicles, IoT devices, and smart cities.
key_points: Data processing closer to source for reduced latency
Critical for autonomous vehicles and IoT devices
Integration with AI for autonomous and adaptive systems

articles.title: Robotics and Automation in Manufacturing and Healthcare
articles.summary: Advanced robotic systems combining AI, machine learning, and sensors are working alongside humans in factories, hospitals, and homes, enhancing precision, efficiency, and safety across industries.
key_points: Collaborative robots working alongside humans
Healthcare robots assisting in surgeries and patient care
Manufacturing automation enhancing precision and safety

articles.title: Extended Reality (XR) in Education and Healthcare
articles.summary: Extended reality technologies including AR, VR, and MR are enhancing training, education, and healthcare through immersive experiences, virtual environments, and augmented overlays.
key_points: XR tools enabling interactive classrooms and virtual labs
Healthcare applications in surgical planning and therapy
Business uses for virtual collaboration and product visualization

key_trends: Agentic AI moving from demos to production environments
Major AI model releases with enhanced capabilities
Growing enterprise AI adoption with dedicated budgets
Advances in quantum computing and edge technologies
